arguments.title: Sam’s Restaurant Counteroffer — Household Scheduling Reference
arguments.body:
## Status

This is the scheduling package Sam plans to include in his restaurant counteroffer. It has **not been sent or accepted**; these are proposed protections, not agreed terms.

## Proposed scheduling protections

- **One fixed no-service evening each week.** For the protected weekday, check the current rota records; this reference intentionally does not name the day.
- **At least three weeks’ notice** for the ordinary rota, so household plans can be made against a predictable schedule.
- **No default private-event coverage** on the protected evening. Menu or event responsibilities should not automatically turn that evening into a service shift.
- **Clarify the extra-closes expectation:** ask whether the offer’s two additional closes per month would remain a fixed requirement under these protections.

For household planning, treat the protections as requested conditions—not confirmed schedule terms—until the restaurant responds and the counteroffer is accepted in writing.
